Spotlight: Refused to race on last visit here when due to contest a handicap hurdle in October; won over an extended 1m3f and 2m back on the Flat this month, scoring by 19l last week at Nottingham when 2lb well in under a penalty; that was an apprentice race so has no penalty.
Only 1-16 on turf Flat and 5-25 on the AW, but latest return to form at Kempton (2m) bodes well for him giving Hope Rising something to think about.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner whose losing run is up to 16 despite a declining mark, but his second of three behind an improver (who has gone in again since) at Newbury (2m, good to firm) last month wasn't a bad effort; shortlisted.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Nine wins on the AW including one over C&D; 2lb lower than when successful at Kempton (2m, Polytrack) in February and makes the shortlist; jockey having her first ride under rules.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Took him a while to get off the mark, but has won three times over 1m4f on the AW this year including one here (under Jessica Llewellyn); back off his last winning mark and holds each-way claims if seeing out the new trip.

RaceName: Trade Centre Group Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

RaceName: Trade Centre Group Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beaten 11l when 25-1 for recent debut here, finishing 8l behind Rogue Dakota.

RaceName: Trade Centre Group Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Outpaced when it mattered at Leicester (6f; 18-1), beating just the one home; has to improve on that effort.

RaceName: Trade Centre Group Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Inexperience evident at Windsor (6f; tongue tied) so did well to go close in a bunched finish; that wasn't a strong race but it's something to build on.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Band D) (Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: March foal by Sergei Prokofiev; half-sister to winners Drama (6f including 2yo/AW; RPR 101), Thanos (7f/1m; 77) and Sidcot Swallet (Qatari 6f); dam 5f turf 2yo/6f AW winner (75), half-sister to 5f 2yo Group 3 winner Monsieur Chevalier; the only debutante in the field, but the stable has had a couple of winning 2yo newcomers this month; worth a market check.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Band D) (Qualifier) (GBB Race)

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Band D) (Qualifier) (GBB Race)

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Band D) (Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Improved from her debut effort when third of nine at Wolverhampton (7f, Tapeta) four weeks ago, though the trip just appeared to stretch her; one for the shortlist back at 6f.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Band D) (Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 66-1 when beating one home on her debut here (7f) a fortnight ago; may need more time and a return to further.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Band D) (Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Sent off 22-1 and ran green when fourth of seven on her debut on turf here (6f, good to firm) last month; half-sister to a Polytrack winner and is open to improvement.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Band D) (Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Placed in three consecutive starts on varying ground over 5f on turf before finishing in midfield in the Super Sprint (100-1); extra furlong shouldn't be a problem and is a half-sister to a dual Polytrack winner, including around here; high on list.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Band D) (Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Big prices and beaten a long way in three starts over 5f/7f on turf; makes no appeal.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Band D) (Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 66-1 when fifth of six on her Windsor debut (6f, good to firm) 15 days ago; wasn't beaten far but still needs to improve.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Band D) (Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Sent off 9-2 when a promising third of 12 on her Doncaster debut (6.5f, good to firm) 17 days ago; slight drop in trip may be a positive and this half-sister to an AW winner is a major player granted normal improvement.

RaceName: Bailey Family Investments / EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Encouraging second at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) but took a backward step at Ffos Las where he pulled hard and dropped away; could be given another chance but he's up against a good prospect in Grove Street.

RaceName: Bailey Family Investments / EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 200,000gns foal out of a 1m/1m4f winner; stable's juveniles are well known for improving on their initial efforts and this colt pushed last week's Listed winner Quest For Stars close when making his debut at Sandown (7f, good to firm; 16-1); has two Group 2 entries.

RaceName: Bailey Family Investments / EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Third foal; half-brother to 1m4f AW winner Havachoc (RPR 67); dam 7f 2yo/1m2f Flat (95) and 2m hurdle winner; likely best watched.

RaceName: Bailey Family Investments / EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: P J & Mrs J P Haycock
Spotlight: Has posted modest RPRs in his first two races and likely to be outclassed while kept to maidens.

RaceName: Bailey Family Investments / EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Eighth foal; brother to 7f/1m winner Bill The Butcher (RPR 91) and half-brother to three winners including Fev Rover (7f-1m2f; Canadian Grade 1; 118) and Patrol (1m 2yo/1m4f AW; 85); dam 7f 2yo winner (83); in good hands and the market should be revealing.

RaceName: Bailey Family Investments / EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 160,000euros yearling by Wootton Bassett; contested a traditionally warm maiden at Glorious Goodwood (7f, good to firm) but she was never remotely threatening from off the pace at odds of 28-1; the only filly in this field and other runners appeal more.

OwnerName: M Robinson, Jack Pook & Jeanette May
Spotlight: Came from the rear to get up to win a similar contest over C&D last Tuesday; has more on his plate here with a 5lb penalty but current winning form is rare in such contests so he comes back here with decent claims.
Placed in a couple of handicaps earlier this year but beaten 25l and 13l on last two Flat starts; has another change of headgear with blinkers replacing a visor but has plenty to prove.
0-27 on the Flat and although he was runner-up here on the turf track (11.5f, good to firm) two weeks ago, he does not appeal for win purposes.

Has suffered some heavy defeats of late, but almost sprang a 80-1 surprise when only headed close home by Foinix over C&D last Tuesday; if he is able to back up that run then he comes here with a shout.
Hasn't gone on since getting off the mark in a Southwell handicap (1m) in January, but steps up in trip in her first classified and may have more to give.

Won at this track (1m) for Stan Moore in 2024; has shown little in two starts for current yard since returning from a lengthy absence; the step up in trip in his first classified needs to have a positive impact.

A fair winning hurdler/chaser for Gordon Elliott but signed off for that yard out of form and has been beaten a long way on his two runs for current handler; drops into his first classified and needs to show more.
Placed a couple of times in handicaps here (1m/1m2f) earlier in year after the cheekpieces went on, but the novelty seemed to wear off and she is now 0-16; steps back up in trip but hard to fancy.

OwnerName: Hambleton Racing Lvi & Mrs G Jarvis
Spotlight: Well held in three similar contests this year; first-time cheekpieces replace blinkers and she needs to get her act together.
Well beaten at big prices in three maidens; this represents a significant drop in class and she steps up in trip; fascinating contender and any market move could be significant.

RaceName: Trade Centre Wales Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)

RaceName: Trade Centre Wales Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Has done his winning at trips between 6f and 1m; losing run goes back to March 2024 but, following a spell in the doldrums for previous yard and this one, he's been back in better form of late, doing some good late work on the AW at Kempton (1m) and Wolverhampton (about 1m1f); can be involved with Tom Marquand up for the first time

RaceName: Trade Centre Wales Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Maiden who made an encouraging return from an absence on the AW (1m) last October but he hasn't achieved a lot since and was beaten a fair way out at Ffos Las in July on his yard debut; one to watch for now.

RaceName: Trade Centre Wales Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: First turf win when beating three rivals at Bath (1m, firm) in May; she's run creditably over this C&D in the meantime, notably when checked in her run but keeping at it two starts ago; lesser run next time but she's run well both times Rossa Ryan has ridden her and should do so again.

RaceName: Trade Centre Wales Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Broke duck at Yarmouth (1m2f, good to firm) in May 2025 and some good efforts in defeat followed later in the year; however, it's been a slow process recapturing form for new yard and was well held when second of five back at Yarmouth recently; no good thing to take advantage of a tempting mark.

RaceName: Trade Centre Wales Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: All three wins at about 1m, most recently over C&D in June (good; has won on good to firm), but his form has taken a turn for the worse since, over 1m (on two occasions) and 1m4f; has plenty to prove; usually wears aids but not today.

RaceName: Trade Centre Wales Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: The winner of three of his six C&D starts (good and good to firm), all in July or August; well treated these days and he looked on the way back when hampered over 7f here in July and he again didn't get the clearest of runs over C&D nine days ago; solid contender.

RaceName: Trade Centre Wales Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Sole win from 23 turf starts came over C&D in June; two good efforts in his next two course starts (on good and good to firm) but his finishing effort was muted over C&D nine days ago; in the thick of it on the earlier form.

Well beaten on handicap/AW debut over C&D in April, but has suddenly taken off on turf lately with two wins at Windsor (1m, good to firm), the first under Jude Fernandes; has a 6lb penalty to carry, but still a major player if his progress can be transferred back to Polytrack.

Hinted at ability in his final start for Donnacha O'Brien when fourth of 12 in a Dundalk maiden (1m, Polytrack) in February, but beaten a long way in two turf handicaps for this yard; best watched for now.

Didn't match up to market expectations in her first three starts for William Haggas, but ran better when fifth of ten on handicap debut at Redcar (7f, good) where she would have gone even closer with a clear run; makes her debut for her new yard after three months off having changed hands for 22,000gns last month; out of a Polytrack winner; watch market.

Responded well to the fitting of cheekpiece when bolting up at Southwell (1m, Tapeta) in January on his final start for Joseph O'Brien, but he took a big hike in the weights and has looked held since; another 1lb drop not enough to tempt.
Offered some promise when fourth of nine in a Wolverhampton maiden (7f, Tapeta) last November, but can't be entertained on his three efforts in the meantime.

Has improved since switched to this C&D with cheekpieces added, finishing second of ten behind a dual subsequent winner last month before narrowly winning a 0-50 classified event; this race will demand more, but something has clicked and she has less to prove than a few.
Unplaced in seven starts and has a bit to find with Henfield on last month's C&D running.

OwnerName: S R Hope And S W Barrow
Spotlight: Won a 5f maiden here (good to firm) last August on her second start; hasn't kicked on in handicaps over 6f and she'll need to accept the new headgear (blinkered for previous runs) if she's to see out this longer trip.
Second at Yarmouth and still looked green when narrowly justifying prohibitive odds at Lingfield (7f, good to firm); has the potential to deal with this sort of mark now handicapping.

AW winner who doubled his tally when grabbing the favoured stands' rail here 12 days ago; prevailed by only half a length and has a 5lb higher mark today (also had claimed 3lb off his back last time); perhaps vulnerable.
Won her maiden over C&D in July but has finished last in both her handicaps, over 1m and an extended 7f (latterly tongue tied); something to prove all of a sudden.
Took nine races to get off the mark but he was quite convincing in the end at Doncaster (7f) 17 days ago; should be very competitive off 7lb higher if in similar form.

Looked in a spot of bother over Bath's extended 5f (firm) but came home the best, albeit at odds-on in a modest race (form let down since); it's unlikely she has a great deal in hand off this mark in her first handicap, but this is perhaps more her trip.
C&D winner in July off 2lb lower; below that level since and he's the most exposed of these (2-36).

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div I)
Spotlight: Has gone the wrong way since showing early promise for Eve Johnson Houghton and is now 0-18; hard to recommend, even at this level.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div I)
Spotlight: C&D winner, but held at this level in her last two starts and needs to get back on track.

Spotlight: Won a handicap over C&D in September 2023, but that his only success in 27 starts; plenty to prove back from six month off.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div I)
Spotlight: Sole success came in a handicap over C&D in March, but last three efforts not amongst his best; dropping to this grade for the first time one reason for optimism.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div I)
Spotlight: Useful 2yo for Charles Hills and although a long way below that level now, his third-place finishes in handicaps here (1m) and at Ffos Las (7.4f, good) in March suggested that some ability remains; respected down to this level for the first time.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div I)
Spotlight: Sole success in 29 starts came in a handicap over C&D a year ago, but he has been running with credit in similar company here lately and is likely to go well again.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div I)
Spotlight: 0-10 and may have been flattered when third of six in a 0-55 handicap at Leicester (1m, good to firm) on her penultimate start; others are more convincing.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div I)
Spotlight: Sole win in 23 starts came in a handicap at Newcastle (5f, Tapeta) in February when trained by Brian Ellison; drops to this level for the first time, but has been well held in both starts for this yard and attempts this far for the first time; cheekpieces return.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div I)
Spotlight: 0-13, but has twice finished runner-up including in a 0-60 handicap on turf here (7f, good) in May; twice well held since, but this is a drop in grade and possible frame material if producing her best.

Well backed and took advantage of a sliding mark when winning an uncompetitive small-field handicap off 3lb lower at Lingfield (turf) in June; always liked it here but this mark is as high as she's ever won off, so there's little margin for error.

On a career-low mark for a yard that doesn't send many here and he is worth tracking in the market; seems on the downgrade, though, and he hasn't run at beyond 5f since 2023; others make more obvious appeal.

Seven-time course winner who's become hard to win with, landing just one of her last 30 starts; she's not been this low in the weights for years but isn't as good now; yard also responsible for Savannah Smiles.
Seems happiest on Tapeta, albeit he's a course winner, and has still to prove he's up to this mark on turf; two poor efforts this summer, after a break, leave him some way down the pecking order.

Kempton win last autumn came when she was fresh, as did her Leicester victory three weeks ago (during a good spell for yard; gone quieter since); a 5lb rise for winning that small-field affair from the front will test her.

Seven-time AW winner (7f-1m4f) when trained in Ireland, latterly in a Dundalk claimer in March; has failed to make the frame in 13 starts on grass, though, hence his much lower turf mark; lots to prove for his new yard.

Won this last year, one of three C&D victories, for Charlie Tucker off a 2lb higher mark in a small field; yard enjoying a better spell of late and this may have been the plan but he doesn't arrive in the same form as last year; the years might be catching up.

Pulled hard on his first two runs back from wind surgery (7f) and was much happier being allowed to stride on when easily winning an apprentice handicap over C&D last Sunday; no penalty and he can only look well treated now back in the groove.

C&D winner in June (drop to 6f helped) off 5lb lower, who finished best of the rest, and just ahead of stablemate Some Nightmare, behind Arnaz here nine days ago; will do well to turn that round on the same terms.

OwnerName: Mrs S M Maine & Roger Gould & Partner
Spotlight: Six-time course winner who's been on the downgrade for some time and is on a losing run of 18; remains consistent enough but, like stablemate Marisitta, has a job on with Arnaz on the same terms as last Sunday.

Four-time AW winner; sole success on turf came in 2021; despite negatives attached to her turf record and a hefty burden, holds a definite chance on her second in a 22-runner handicap at Leopardstown 12 days ago.

fair sixth in a 20-runner handicap over 1m5f at Navan in April, beaten only 3l and would have been closer with a clear run; another respectable run when third in a 1m4f event of this type at Limerick in June; shorter trip might not be ideal.

OwnerName: W Keeling & M C Grassick & Mrs M J Grassick
Spotlight: Veteran seven-time winner; has a good record at this track, one win and two seconds from four visits; has been running consistently in handicaps; capable of reaching the money in a race of this standard.
Ordinary form in maidens; struggled at Fairyhouse in his first handicap; not suited by the race conditions; two items of headgear added.

Holding his form generally well since an early-season win at Cork, apart from a below-par run at Ballinrobe last month; back to form with a solid effort in finishing fourth of 17 at Galway only eight days later.

Twice successful for Joseph O'Brien last year; has failed to take to hurdling for this stable; well below best on both Flat starts this term; needs to step up from a poor Ballinrobe run behind She's Ideal; highest-rated of Denis Hogan's three runners, so might be unwise to ignore
One of three for yard; took a big climb in the ratings for a Gowran win; hung badly left when in rear in a handicap at Galway; well beaten in a claimer at Gowran recently.

Two wins for Richard Hannon, both over 1m2f on easy ground; modest form so far over hurdles and on the Flat for this yard; soundly beaten in the Ballinrobe claimer won by She's Ideal; struggled at Sligo last time; cheekpieces tried now.

Three-time Flat winner, went up 11lb for a convincing success in a 1m4f handicap at Tramore last month; subsequent runs in a Flat handicap at Galway and a maiden hurdle at Kilbeggan raise significant doubts; well enough treated by the race conditions if recapturing form.
Fine record on AW (4-10), 1-18 on turf, unconvincing form since Fairyhouse win in May; would receive 9lb from stablemate Forlio in a handicap.

Ran respectably in a couple of handicaps earlier this season; several less encouraging displays before winning a claimer for Paul Flynn at Ballinrobe last month; raised 6lb for winning a 0-60 handicap at Gowran last week on debut for Ado McGuinness; had a fairly hard race, but has a strong chance if fully recovered.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div II)
Spotlight: One win in 19 starts came in a handicap at Chelmsford (7f, Polytrack; first-time blinkers) in December and only went down narrowly over this C&D later in month; not at her best in her last two starts, but this drop in grade gives her a chance.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div II)
OwnerName: The Limes Of Epsom Racing Club
Spotlight: Beaten a long way in all four starts; drops in grade with blinkers added, but still hard to warm to.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div II)
Spotlight: 1-23, the win coming in a nursery here (6f) at the end of 2024; will need to improve on recent efforts if he is to double his tally.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div II)
Spotlight: 0-19 since winning twice early last year but has run with credit in a few handicaps this year and looks frame material; never dangerous from the widest draw in the 7.40 Wolverhampton (5f; his first classified) on Monday but made some late headway.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div II)
Spotlight: 0-23 since winning a pair of Kempton handicaps (7f, Polytrack) in the winter of 2023/24; only found one too good in a handicap at Wolverhampton (6f, Tapeta) last month, but his subsequent effort underlined his inconsistency.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div II)
Spotlight: Made a promising return when third of 11 in a novice at Kempton (7f, Polytrack) in March last year, but has come nowhere near that form since; drops in grade, but still needs a resurgence.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div II)
Spotlight: Sole success came in a Kempton handicap (7f, Polytrack) last October, but comes into this off the back of three consecutive runner-up finished in similar events on turf; should go well again.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div II)
Spotlight: Not very consistent, but has won nine races, eight on the AW; twice well held since winning a handicap at Newcastle (6f, Tapeta) in June, but more than capable of playing a part if on a going day.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div II)
Spotlight: Won a Wolverhampton nursery (7f, Tapeta) for Jack Morland last November, but well held in both starts since returning for this yard last month; needs to get back on track, but this is a drop in grade.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div II)
Spotlight: Hasn't threatened in five starts over 5f/6f on the AW; drops in grade, but probably only of interest if backed.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div II)
Spotlight: Hasn't finished within 10l of the winner in seven starts; look elsewhere.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Promising third of 11 on debut at Kempton (1m, AW) in March; absence since is a slight concern but otherwise he holds fair claims.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beat only one home on debut at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) last month; drops back in trip on AW debut and should know more this time.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beaten over 17l when fourth of five on debut at Yarmouth (1m2f, good to firm) 13 days ago; has a lot of improvement to find.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Promising second of four on debut at Chelmsford (7f, AW) last November; she makes a belated return to action but the booking of Oisin Murphy may be significant.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Never competitive after starting slowly when seventh of 12 on debut at Newcastle (1m, AW) in April; has had wind surgery since so she may step up.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: R J Manning & Mrs Fiona Williams
Spotlight: Beat only one rival in her two races on turf last year; first-time cheekpieces are applied on AW debut; best watched.
Last-but-one in his first two races; perhaps premature to write off since he cost 500,000gns as a yearling and is a half-brother to a Group 1 winner; however, hard to make a logical case for him.
No sign of progression in maidens; had a troubled passage in a Galway nursery won by a stablemate; that was mildly encouraging, but he needs to improve considerably to win a maiden.
Hinted at improvement at Galway on his second outing; finished only one length behind fourth-placed Someday Somewhere in a 7f maiden.

OwnerName: Kiva Cromwell & Coragh Bloodstock Limited & Fergus Grimes
Spotlight: Noted staying on when sixth of 17 on debut over 6f at Fairyhouse; third in a C&D maiden seven weeks ago; form is working out well enough to give him a decent chance, second and fifth have both won.
From a top stable but not one of the stronger contenders on the evidence of runs at Killarney and Leopardstown.

Dropped away in the final quarter-mile when 100-1 chance first time out at the Curragh; had plenty of horses behind him when sixth at Naas on his second start, fifth-placed Ile De France won at Dundalk on Saturday; first time with cheekpieces.

Promise on debut at Leopardstown over 7f (soft) and built on that over a mile at Bellewstown on good ground; 7f seemed a little too sharp at Down Royal; one of the more likely contenders despite a reservation about the trip.
Looks more like a handicap prospect than a potential maiden winner after two Curragh outings; hooded now.
Beaten further at Leopardstown last month than at the same venue on debut; up against it.
Finished with only one behind her when 33-1 on debut at Naas in May; showed good progress from that when seventh of 19 at the Curragh nine days ago; needs to find more, may be capable of doing so.
Showed a little at Sligo on her second outing; will probably need to get a handicap mark.
Definite promise when third behind an odds-on chance on debut at Leopardstown; confirmed ability when fourth at Galway; capable of making her presence felt.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Last three wins have come over 5f but he has won three times over 6f, including around here; held lately, but he drops to this level for the first time in over two years and is 4-9 in 0-60 handicaps or lower; interesting.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Emphatic winner of a Leicester novice (6f, good to firm) for Andrew Balding in July last year, but inconsistent since and well held in both starts since returning for this yard last month; others preferred.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Returned to winning form in a 0-50 classified event at Wolverhampton (5f, Tapeta) last month and followed up in a 0-65 handicap at Ffos Las (5f, good) six days ago; has a 5lb penalty to carry, but still respected in her current mood and the return to this trip is no problem.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Placed on nine occasions, but now 0-16 and 5f appears to suit her best; another frame finish may be her best hope.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Nine-time winner including one over C&D; 2lb lower than when successful at Kempton (6f, Polytrack) in January, but well held in all three starts since and is hard to predict.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: 3-37 with two of his wins coming at Chester; one of his better efforts since joining this yard when beaten just over 2l into fourth of ten over C&D a fortnight ago; worth considering from 7lb below his last winning mark.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Doubled his winning tally when successful over C&D in April; twice unplaced on turf since and still 5lb higher than for that latest win, but still one for the shortlist returned here.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div I)
OwnerName: A Bangs & Miss J A Challen
Spotlight: Seven wins on the AW elsewhere; surrounded by subsequent winners when beaten half a length into second of five at Leicester (6f, good to firm) last month and a 1lb rise still leaves him 6lb below his last winning mark; shortlisted.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Front-runner who has dropped 3lb lower than for the latest of two wins at Newmarket (1m, good to soft) last summer; has never tackled a trip this short before, though.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Slowly away and always behind on Kempton debut (7f; 28-1, beaten 21l) in late June; this half-brother to the 7f AW-1m2f turf winner Titanium is poorly drawn and likely to need more time; look elsewhere.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 20,000gns yearling; modest late headway when beaten about 10l on Southwell debut (6f; 28-1) four weeks ago; moves up in trip, with Hector Crouch taking over in the saddle; stablemate of Brazilian Blitz.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 26,000gns yearling; fourth foal; out of 5f winner (RPR 96); half-brother to two winners, principally Ange De L'Amour (6f 2yo; 72); stable aren't a regular source of winners in these events, and he's already gelded; monitor only.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Third foal; out of a 1m3f-1m4f AW winner (RPR 89); satisfactory start to his career when fourth to  more experienced rival at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm; 13-2) 16 days ago; likely to know more on this occasion.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 25,000euros yearling; some promise when sixth on Southwell debut (6f; 17-2) in July when beaten 8l; half-brother to six winners, including the milers Whispering Bell (RPR 90) and Stardayz (81), so the extra furlong is worth exploring.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 8,000gns foal, 38,000gns yearling; second foal; out of a 7f winner (including AW; RPR 89); already gelded but, with Oisin Murphy booked (1-3 for the yard in the last five seasons), he merits market scrutiny and consideration for a trainer operating a 13% juvenile strike-rate in 2026 (2-15 on AW).

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Half-brother to the frequent scorer Oj Lifestyle (7f-1m2f; RPR 92); clear encouragement from opening effort when fifth of 12 at Southwell (7f; 20-1) three weeks ago; should progress and have a role to play.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Weakened to finish last of nine on Yarmouth debut (7f, good to firm; 80-1) 16 days ago; switches to AW but no real reason why he should get closer to Javelot (fourth) this time.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 28,000gns breeze-up purchase; dwelt and ran green throughout on last week's Kempton debut (7f; 40-1) when beaten 13l; hard to consider as a viable contender on that evidence.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Few positives to take from AW runs at Newcastle and Southwell (both 7f); will soon be eligible for a handicap mark; unlikely today.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Nick Bradley Racing 6 & Hold My Beer
Spotlight: 42,000euros yearling; weakened to finish last of 12 on last week's Kempton debut (7f; 40-1); this swift turnaround is another part of the learning curve; others more obvious.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Slowly away and failed to figure in either start at 7f and 1m; her dam was a lightly raced half-sister to the Group 2 winner Nyaleti (1m), but this one looks like she'll need more time; handicaps await soon.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Race (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Given three runs in nine days in May to get a handicap mark; lost out narrowly at the Curragh in his first handicap; made short work of his rivals in a Galway nursery; now rated 92, 18lb above initial mark; should win more races, but Dylan Browne McMonagle prefers the less experienced Green Dreamer.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Race (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Stable second-choice on debut in Killarney maiden, shaped well in fifth; looked useful when beating subsequent Curragh winner Shakespeare at Leopardstown only ten days later; significant that the champion jockey prefers him to the 92-rated Seven Nation Army; the only horse in the race with Group 1 entries.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Race (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Steven I Weston & Steven Rocco & Steven Bouchey
Spotlight: Won quite snugly on debut at Down Royal two winners; several subsequent winners behind then, including two Galway festival scorers, Joga Bonito and today's rival Oristown Boy; promising sort.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Race (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Won a Curragh maiden over 5f in heavy ground on second start; posted a solid effort in a 6f Group 3 next time; a couple of lesser efforts over 6f before a good run over 5f at Cork last time; some of these may have an edge over him in terms of stamina.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Race (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Finished strongly when fourth to Noble Agenda at Down Royal; stayed 7f well when winning at Galway; Noble Agenda may have his measure again.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Race (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Chased home a well-fancied filly at Sligo on debut; improvement likely, but might not match some of the previous winners.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Race (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Already fading when hampered at Leopardstown; likely to need more experience.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Race (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Made all for an emphatic win at Gowran on her second outing, beating a 79-rated rival who has since finished third to Oristown Boy at Galway; can hold her own with the colts and geldings here.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Race (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Never looked like posing a threat in the Galway maiden won by Oristown Boy; huge task here.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Not yet off the mark and he was down the field on turf at Doncaster when last seen in June but he acted well on Polytrack in Ireland and a close third of 12 on Newcastle Tapeta (6f) in May was encouraging; possibilities.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div II)
OwnerName: P R Hedger & P C F Racing Ltd
Spotlight: Multiple AW wins include two over this C&D, although his most recent success came on turf in April; has taken rather a drastic wrong turn since, though, and refitting cheekpieces (now discarded) made no difference back on this track last time.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: In good form over 6f on turf since blinkered, winning at Yarmouth in June and going down narrowly there last month; having first AW run since before Christmas but he was in good form then and a bold show looks likely.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Particularly successful on Tapeta but he was a wide-margin winner over C&D in June and again won from the front at Wolverhampton in his only subsequent AW run; the chasers were closing there but he had the race in the bag from some way out and, back up 3lb, he looks sure to go well again.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Won 6f maiden on Chelmsford Polytrack as a 2yo and he looked a useful prospect when winning a 6f handicap at Newmarket in May 2025; however, he's had more horses in front of him than behind ever since and wind surgery (his second) since last seen in May needs to have made a big difference.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Course winner at 1m; a good spell in the New Year included a 7f win on Wolverhampton AW and he was back on song when winning over 6f at Nottingham in June; soft ground perhaps not helpful on next two starts but he has a bit to prove on his first C&D run.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Won on Polytrack in Ireland; three Wolverhampton AW wins for this yard, seemingly suited by the return to 6f when drawing clear in April; respectable efforts on turf either side of a break since (visor discarded latest, blinkers now refitted) and he's relatively unexposed at this trip on the AW so could have some improvement to come.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Off the mark in a 6f classified on Chelmsford AW in February; his handicap form since hasn't come up to scratch and although he wasn't beaten far in a C&D classified last time he has more to prove back at this level.

RaceName: Visit wolverhampton-racecourse.co.uk To Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: Missed more than 18 months prior to a few lesser efforts in the spring, but has found his level again; enjoyed the run of the race when winning narrowly on Polytrack last Wednesday but set to go well again under a penalty for a yard in good nick.

RaceName: Visit wolverhampton-racecourse.co.uk To Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: Three turf wins over a straight 1m for Edward Bethell as a 3yo, latterly off a 2lb lower mark, before struggling during a limited campaign last year; would need a career-best effort for his new yard (also responsible for Spaceman) back from 11 months off.

RaceName: Visit wolverhampton-racecourse.co.uk To Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: Dual 7f Polytrack winner in his younger days but does most racing now over 6f; made a poor debut in a claimer for his new yard here last month, having been picked up for 10,000gns from Richard Hughes last autumn; surprise to see him take this.

RaceName: Visit wolverhampton-racecourse.co.uk To Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: Won her maiden on Tapeta and turned in her best effort of the year back on the AW over C&D late last month, when coming away with the winner/favourite; not as well drawn tonight and is 3lb higher but holds claims nonetheless.

RaceName: Visit wolverhampton-racecourse.co.uk To Book Now Handicap
OwnerName: P C J Dalby & R D Schuster
Spotlight: Found the race not run to suit at Epsom early last month, when hanging left, but then pulled way too hard in front on his Tapeta debut latest; that was far from the first time he'd over-raced and much will hinge on how he settles early from the inside stall.

RaceName: Visit wolverhampton-racecourse.co.uk To Book Now Handicap
OwnerName: A Pot To Pete In Syndicate
Spotlight: Dual Southwell winner off lower marks early in the year who ran poorly there when last seen and has been off for almost four months since; would need a career-best in order to take this.

RaceName: Visit wolverhampton-racecourse.co.uk To Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: Winner here off 2lb lower last October, his third over C&D; last month's Chester comeback from a short break should have brought him on and he holds each-way claims under Oisin Murphy, who boasts a good record for the yard.

RaceName: Visit wolverhampton-racecourse.co.uk To Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: Shaped with a deal of promise on his first run at beyond sprint trips/handicap debut at Southwell three weeks ago, when not helped by the way the race panned out; will have learned more again from that and should go well.

RaceName: Visit wolverhampton-racecourse.co.uk To Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: Generally struggled early in the year and returns from a break of five months; wins have all come after a recent outing and does most of his racing at a lower level now, so has a bit to overcome.

RaceName: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Has shown nothing in three outings in recent months; can be ruled out.

RaceName: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Last of five at Killarney on belated debut; never in serious contention at Galway.

RaceName: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Fair fourth over 1m at Leopardstown on the second of two starts at two; appeared not to see out the extended 1m1f at Gowran on return; better when going close over C&D; looks the part now after a Galway run that can be upgraded a little since she suffered interference from a loose horse.

RaceName: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Made a promising debut at Sligo, taking the runner-up spot despite betraying inexperience; got going too late at Cork and appears held by Stooked; both fillies are likely to appreciate the extra furlong.

RaceName: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Frankel filly started her career with a fifth placing in a 1m Leopardstown maiden in which the subsequent Oaks winner Thundering On was second; again fifth in a 1m2f maiden at the same venue, beaten 9 1/2l behind the Irish Oaks Johanna Walsh; not much improvement in evidence at Naas on third start.

RaceName: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: E200,000 yearling; second foal; by French Classic winner Victor Ludorum; dam, by Camelot, a French Listed-placed 1m1f winner; interesting on belated debut.

RaceName: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Has finished towards the back at Fairyhouse and Naas; can be left out of calculations.

RaceName: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Ninth foal; half-sister by Kodi Bear to three winners including Aquamerica (French Listed-placed); dam 1m2f winner, half-sister to US 1m Grade 3 winner Doc Holiday.

RaceName: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Fair debut over 7f at Down Royal, possibly found 6f inadequate at the Curragh; stable among the winners last weekend.

RaceName: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: Exors of the Late J Connaughton
Spotlight: Took a step in the right direction at Limerick in April; more needed now after a break; others preferred.

RaceName: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith
Spotlight: Siyouni filly out of 7f 2yo Group 3 winner Coolmore, sister to Group 1 winners Gleneagles, Marvellous, Happily, and Joan Of Arc; 10-1 stable second-string when fourth over 7f at Cork in April on testing ground (odds-on stablemate was second and won easily next time).

RaceName: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Third foal; Churchill filly is closely related to Kashel Spring who won twice for Joseph O'Brien last year.

RaceName: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan
Spotlight: Best effort at two when a close fourth in a 6f Naas maiden; flopped in a Dundalk nursery on final start before the winter; made a pleasing return at the Curragh; failed to build on that at Limerick; needs extra.

RaceName: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: 30,000gns yearling; fourth foal; Havana Grey filly; dam unraced half-sister to two useful French winners; trainer also runs the twice-raced Andaman Fifty who has been placed.

RaceName: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Made a promising debut when beaten a head by a more experienced rival at the Curragh, form upheld by the winner in landing a handicap at Gowran; probably found 6f inadequate when runner-up at Cork only six days later; almost sure to be in the mix.

OwnerName: The Hon Heather Galbraith & C Maxwell
Spotlight: Gave willingly to brush off a 5lb penalty at Musselburgh (1m1f, good) 11 days ago; steps up in grade (from 4lb higher) in pursuit of the hat-trick for an in-form trainer; no issue with this track, so obvious claims with Oisin Murphy aboard.

OwnerName: Mrs R Coleman And G Glendining
Spotlight: Runner-up at Kempton (1m; 11-4 favourite) on penultimate start, and didn't get the breaks at Windsor (1m) subsequently; has a few foibles - unseated rider in the paddock at Newmarket - but she's still a possible from 2lb above last winning mark.

Placed on first start for this trainer at Southwell (1m; hooded) in April; hasn't kicked on since, but did emerge with a suitable excuse (lost both hind shoes) when a beaten 6-4 favourite at Nottingham (1m2f) latest; slowly easing mark.

Not many positives to take from her efforts in novice/maiden company, 'the pick' a never dangerous fourth of ten at Pontefract (1m2f; 40-1) in early July; AW switch, and visor, could yield improvement on handicap debut.

12-race maiden; some consistent efforts though, losing out narrowly on her last two starts, including to Sunshine And Roses over C&D; handicap mark continues to rise (up another 2lb) which won't make life easier; still merits respect.

Uplift for fitting of a hood (absent tonight), and a switch to handicap company; lacked pace when third at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm; 12-1) four weeks ago; dropping back to 8.5f isn't the most obvious play, but she's on the same mark.
0-8; weakened late when runner-up over 9.5f here (12-1) in May; has regressed race by race since; returns to AW in added visor with plenty to prove.

Ex-French; modest turf efforts (7f-1m) for this trainer, easing a further 2lb since finishing fourth at Ripon (1m, good; 7-2, didn't find much off the bridle) a fortnight ago; more positively, that form received a minor boost at Doncaster on Saturday.

Pounced to break her duck over C&D (beat Blue Celestial by half-a-length) on penultimate start; gave a good account of herself back on turf when second at Haydock (1m) subsequently; it's likely she'll be in the mix again with Rose Dawes retaining the ride.

Hasn't managed to beat too many rivals across four starts and was last of seven on Ripon handicap debut (1m, good; 9-1) one month ago; now 2lb lower, with added cheekpieces, for AW return; tough to consider.
Won twice last season but this season's form nowhere near that level; handicapper relenting but needs to get back to best.

OwnerName: Nigel O'Hare & Martin W White & Mark Devlin & C G Bryson
Spotlight: Two wins at the Curragh this season, both over 7f on good ground; not a bad run off revised mark over 1m there on latest and probably has more improvement to come but tricky draw to contend with here.
C&D winner; knocking on the door in recent starts; beaten 2.5l when third at Galway on latest; runner up over C&D in May off 2lb lower; frame claims again, especially if it rains.

Maiden winner over 6f last year; mixed bag so far this term; ran a cracker off this mark when beaten a neck at Naas (7f, good) last month; didn't back that up over 6f back there 15 days ago when upset in stalls; needs to rebound.
Well backed and found just one too good on handicap debut at Gowran 11 days ago; 3lb rise for that pleasing effort negated by rider's 5lb claim; could go one place better now.
9yo a winner of seven races; won twice last season at the Listowel Festival on heavy ground and has shaped encouragingly on last two starts at Limerick and Galway; rain would boost claims.
Four-time AW winner is 1-23 on turf; ran well at Bellewstown and Naas earlier this season but way below best the last twice at Leopardstown & Galway; others arrive in better form.
Gained second career win off 5lb lower at Killarney in July (1m, good); has come up short twice since and has a bit to prove off his current mark.

Won a maiden at the Curragh in April (6f, soft); soundly beaten in Listed company on next two starts but back to form when a close third in a fillies' handicap at Fairyhouse (6f, good); not as good over 7f latest and stamina to prove for this trip.

Beaten 2.75l on debut at the Curragh by Thenandnow and 6lb better off with that rival here; got off the mark in a Navan maiden on latest (6f, good); rather speedily bred so whether this trip will suit is up for debate; cheekpieces go on.

Handicap debutante has shown ability in maidens at 7f-1m; beaten just 2l when third in a Killarney maiden on seasonal return last month and ought to be up to winning races off her current mark; drawn wide but not discounted.

Has improved for handicaps; won off 7lb lower at Fairyhouse (7f, good) and another solid effort off revised mark when a close fourth at Naas on latest; can give another good account but very wide draw not ideal.

One of better efforts in maidens came over C&D last year; no impact on seasonal return and handicap debut at Leopardstown in June; eased just 1lb for that and others seemingly have stronger credentials but check the market.

Narrowly denied at Fairyhouse in May (7f, good) and again at Limerick in June (7f, soft); bombed out when failing to beat a rival in a 3yo handicap at Leopardstown last time, however, so comes with risks attached.

Uneven form this season; good third at Gowran before no show at Fairyhouse; bounced back with a close second at Dundalk before heavy defeat at Galway on latest; not the easiest to predict, could go well if in the mood.

Progressive on the AW last winter, winning three times, latterly off tonight's mark; the return to Tapeta and drop back from 7f will help, with the visor experiment quickly binned, but he hasn't been in any form in three runs back from a break.

Found an ordinary 5f handicap when making all at Leicester (first-time cheekpieces) in early summer; put up a harsh 8lb for that, didn't back up the effort next time and has been off for seven weeks since; needs more on his AW debut.

OwnerName: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar
Spotlight: Newly gelded; had excuses with one thing and another this year; this mark looks within range and there are positives back on the AW, and under Oisin Murphy, who boasts a decent record for the yard; shortlisted.

Beat Percy's Star when easily winning his maiden on turf in the spring; difficult to know what happened on his handicap debut off 2lb higher late last month, but possible he needed that and it's still early days.

Won his maiden over C&D in February, since when he's been turned over four times as favourite in handicaps; last two efforts, including one having been gelded, were particularly poor, and leave him plenty to prove; stable in fine form, though.

Bath blowout in the spring can be ignored but he started a big price when last of seven on his return from a break a fortnight ago; while the return to the AW may do the trick, others hold stronger claims.

Ridden positively for two 6f Newcastle wins and found the race not panning out to suit under a more patient ride upped to 7.2f here a month ago; back on her last successful mark and should fare better.

Consistent maiden who's proved competitive in handicaps this season without looking to have anything in hand, or anything left in the way of improvement; still has each-way claims coming back up from 5f.
Ordinary form over jumps in Britain and tailed off on sole previous Flat start on AW; not easy to make a case for on Irish debut.
Tailed off in a German Group 2 and beat just one rival on Irish debut at Down Royal (1m5f, soft); hard to fancy but yard did win this with a 200-1 shot in 2023.

Bumper and maiden hurdle winner has run excellent races in defeat on his first two starts on the Flat; was only 1.5l behind Eagle Fang at Killarney and he has since run a huge race off 90 in the valuable Q.R. handicap at Galway; has to concede weight to most of these but big chance.

OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Beaten just a head on debut at Cork in April (10.5f, good) when sent off the 9-4 favourite; no excuses when beaten 2.25l upped to 1m4f at Leopardstown by now 95-rated rival; had subsequent maiden winners behind that day and he should be on the premises again.

OwnerName: Mrs Pauline McCourt/Donal O'Leary/Whyte's Stamullen Synd
Spotlight: Space Blues gelding; half-brother to 1m4f AW/1m6f turf winner Quantum Leap (RPR 90); dam 7f 2yo winner (78), half-sister to 10.5f Group 1 winner Cutlass Bay & 1m4f Group 2 winner Boscobel; probably best watched on debut.

Reportedly green and lugged left throughout when beaten 4.75l on debut at Leopardstown (1m1f, good); however, he did finish off his race well and he's bred to relish this longer trip; enters calculations.
125-1 and never landed a blow on debut at Leopardstown 12 days ago; safely held by Magnum Cor on that run.
Huge odds and soundly beaten in maidens at Killarney and Gowran; handicaps beckon after this.

Toronado gelding; half-brother to 1m5f-2m winner Carmers (inc Group 2; RPR 115); dam 1m-1m2f winner (inc AW; 88), half-sister to Group 1 winners Lord Shanakill (1m), Forever Together (1m4f) and Together Forever (1m 2yo); blinkered for debut; check the market.
Failed to beat a rival when 33-1 on debut at Ballinrobe; may need a bit more time.
Not a bad effort when fourth on debut at Dundalk in May and similar RPR when last of six at the Curragh on latest; will qualify for handicaps after this.

3yo filly shaped with promise on soft and soft to heavy ground at Gowran and Cork in the spring; below par on good ground at Killarney on latest; rated 77 and gets all the allowances but could probably do with some rain.
Has shown virtually nothing in four maidens at around 1m on a variety of ground; upped in trip and cheekpieces now tried.
Slow away and beat just one rival home on debut at the Curragh in June; Shane Foley jumps ship; others hold more pressing claims.
Heavy defeat on debut at Gowran; beaten 17l when last of 11 at Cork on latest; leap of faith required to back her after those two runs.
Triple-figure odds for both starts and ran accordingly; will be of more interest when tackling handicaps.

Both wins came at this track (1m4f) at the end of last year; runner-up in a couple of turf handicaps since, but was below his best when fifth of eight at Sandown (1m6f, good) last month; the return to this track may see him in a better light.

OwnerName: C Wright, D Kilburn, A Dick And P Snook
Spotlight: Ended last season with two slow-ground wins on turf from the front (1m2f/1m4f); safely held twice on good ground this year (1m4f/1m2f) and needs to show more on this step up in trip on AW return.

Sole success came in a Kempton AW handicap in July last year when trained by Tom Ward; had an unsuccessful stint over hurdles this year for current yard, and well held in a couple of 2m handicaps since; drops back in trip on AW return and best watched for now.

All six wins have been on AW, the latest over C&D last November off 3lb lower; not so good on turf but was runner up at Carlisle (1m6f, good) last Tuesday which holds her in good stead for this return to AW.

Versatile sort whose four wins have all been at this track between 1m4f to around 2m; well-handicapped on his best form but hasn't won for 12 months and some of his younger rivals may have more scope.

11l second to a subsequent Royal Ascot flop in novice at Kempton (1m3f, AW) on debut in May; has finished last in both starts on turf since and return to AW on handicap debut needs to show him in a better light.

Steadily progressive stepping up in trip and got off the mark at the fifth attempt, at Sandown (1m6f, good) in June; wasn't able to handle the step up in class at Newmarket (1m6f, good to firm) last month when fifth of seven but holds obvious claims back on AW at this level.

OwnerName: D Bevan And Mrs D Bevan
Spotlight: Took advantage of a career-low mark and return to Southwell AW, where he had shown his best form previously, to get off the mark last month; 5lb higher and holds claims if able to reproduce his best at this different track.

Has shone since reverting to handicaps, winning twice here (1m4f) and he completed a four-timer at Newbury (15.5f, good to firm) last month; no disgrace in finishing second to a fellow improver at Sandown (1m6f, good to firm) last time and looks sure to be thereabouts.
Handicap debutante has shown promise in all three maidens at 1m1f-1m5f on varying ground; opening mark may be workable and not discounted, especially if money comes.
Won twice on the Flat last year including over C&D off 5lb lower; two runs this term not his best and may need some more help from the handicapper; won't mind if there's rain.
Both previous turf wins have come over 1m but landed a 1m4f handicap at Dundalk in February; eased 4lb for midfield finish at Galway last time and worth checking in the market.
No impact in first two runs for this yard; tailed off on latest at Galway and, while likely capable of better, can only be watched unless the market suggests otherwise.

OwnerName: Athlumney Farms Ltd & Eoin Baxter & Mrs M D O'Callaghan
Spotlight: Sole success came in a 9.5f Ballinrobe claimer last summer; stays this far and should be sharper for latest modest third at Galway but probably hasn't got much in hand off current mark.

Best effort came over 10.5f in an AW maiden; hasn't figured in first two handicaps but did shape okay in a C&D maiden in mid-May; eased 3lb for 6l defeat at Naas on latest, rider takes off further 5lb and cheekpieces go on; interesting.
Six-time winner, most recently at last year's Galway festival over 7f (yielding) off 12lb higher; below best so far in 2026 and stamina a major query on first run beyond 1m2f.
Modest form so far in three maidens at 1m4f-1m6f (including over C&D) and when tailed off in a bumper; bred to do better at some stage so worth a market check on handicap debut.
C&D winner last May off 11lb lower; hinted as though returning to form when an encouraging third at Killarney but then clipped heels and unseated at Galway; likes it here and could go very well.
Maiden has a race in her and she didn't enjoy the smoothest of passages when catching the eye at Galway last time; eased 1lb and if the forecast rain materialises it would boost her prospects.
Won a bumper here last year (2m, good); best run this year came over C&D when a 5l sixth and 4lb lower now; decent run over hurdles at Kilbeggan 10 days ago; place claims if the forecast rain misses.

Likeable front running veteran goes well here; last won over C&D in May 2025 off this mark and was beaten a neck in this race last year, again off this mark; showed he retained ability when second at Fairyhouse in May; trip was too far on latest, could make a bold bid.
Versatile sort won over hurdles at Listowel in June but has failed to fire in that sphere twice since; returns to the Flat in a first-time visor; others arrive in better form.
Not the easiest to win with (1-30) but often runs well in defeat; poor efforts on last three starts, however, and needs to get back on track; yard form a positive.
0-8 last year for Willie McCreery; modest enough start for this yard when beaten 14.5l at Gowran (13.5f, soft); eased 1lb and new headgear combination needs to spark.

Scored at Leopardstown (1m1f, gd-fm) in June off basement mark; hiked up 10lb and beaten just 1l back at Leopardstown before staying on well at Gowran on latest (9.5f, good); worth another go at this trip on that evidence; chance.
